Sam: Midday spike ate ~45% of search budget by 1pm after the creative swap. Need an emergency split: retarget 7d vs 14d, plus two creative variants, keep a 12% holdback. Can someone run this now?

Eli: I can take it. Plan: Creative C vs D, retarget buckets RT_7d and RT_14d, holdback 12%. Canary 8h at 15% spend. Daypart bids -15% 11-14PT.

AdOps Bot: hourly-241234.csv uploaded -> https://storage.redwood.com/ads/241234/hourly.csv (AM CTR -0.5, CPC +10%).

Jade: I'll add negative matches for "free" and "download" and limit keywords to `redwood inference`, `llm inference platform`, `inference cost`. Also disabling auto-bid >10% during test.

Sam: Inbound mapping check (CRM requires gclid + utm_content):
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.com/inbound -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"gclid":"test-241234","utm_campaign":"midday_surge","utm_content":"creativeC_rt7"}'
```

Eli: will implement ad groups and canary now. Scale rule: only scale if CTR >= +5% AND CPL <= -10% vs baseline. pacing_smoothing = 0.3.

Jade: assets uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/midday_split (files: mid_creative_C.jpg, mid_creative_D.jpg, lp_short_C.html, lp_stat_D.html).

AdOps Bot: canary_log_241234.txt -> https://storage.redwood.com/ads/canary/241234/log.txt

Sam: Analytics to create cohorts mid_creative_C_rt7, mid_creative_D_rt14, mid_holdback. Dashboards for CTR, CPC, CPL, SQL rate. Alert if CPL +20% vs baseline for 2 windows. Monitor first 3h and post short updates here.

Eli: deploying canary now. Ping when gclid test passes. :rocket:
